mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, it is a mild 73 degrees with overcast conditions near Harriet Park, and we have a lovely first quarter moon visible this evening.
The city is moving forward with the Mark Drive reconstruction project involving new utility and pavement work, while public works continues to prioritize our connected sidewalk network.
There is plenty to do today, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, and tomorrow you can catch Concerts in the Park at Century School Park.
In a notable incident from Friday, August 15, officers responded to a reckless driver report that resulted in a 29-year-old man being arrested for a second offence O W I.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the delicious Double Strawberry flavor of the day before they close at 10 PM tonight.
